sn56.16:1.1: dhāretha no tumhe bhikkhave mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.16:1.2: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn56.16:1.3: ahaṃ kho bhante dhāremi bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.16:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.16:2.2: dukkhaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
sn56.16:2.3: yo hi koci bhante samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya
sn56.16:2.4: netaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ
sn56.16:2.5: ahametaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññapessāmīti
sn56.16:2.8: dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
sn56.16:2.9: yo hi koci bhante samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya
sn56.16:2.10: netaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ
sn56.16:2.11: ahametaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññapessāmīti
sn56.16:2.13: evaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante dhāremi bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.16:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni.
sn56.16:3.3: dukkhaṃ kho bhikkhu mayā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ tathā naṃ dhārehi.
sn56.16:3.4: yo hi koci bhikkhu samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya
sn56.16:3.5: netaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ
sn56.16:3.6: ahametaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññapessāmīti
sn56.16:3.10: dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā kho bhikkhu mayā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ tathā naṃ dhārehi.
sn56.16:3.11: yo hi koci bhikkhu samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya
sn56.16:3.12: netaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ
sn56.16:3.13: ahametaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññapessāmīti
sn56.16:3.15: evaṃ kho tvaṃ bhikkhu dhārehi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni.
sn56.16:4.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
